Since \(PQR\) is a straight line,
\[
\angle PQS+\angle SQR=180^\circ.
\]
From triangle \(QST\), \(\angle QST=\angle QTS=76^\circ\), so
\[
\angle SQT=180^\circ-76^\circ-76^\circ=28^\circ.
\]
Thus
\[
\angle SQR=\angle SQT+\angle TQR=28^\circ+3x^\circ.
\]
Therefore,
\[
x+(28+3x)=180
\]
\[
4x+28=180
\]
\[
4x=152
\]
\[
x=38.
\]

\[
\boxed{38}
\]
